h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mathura

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mathura

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mathura

c: Mathura and nearby Vrindavan receive pilgrims all year, and many of the city's ashrams, dharamshalas and temple trusts have courtyards or gardens that see daily use. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mathura for these trusts as well as schools, colleges, housing colonies and municipal parks. We make every machine at our factory in Vasai, about 1030 km away.

We send the equipment to Uttar Pradesh by road, and our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes it in place. Mathura's summers are very hot, and the winters along the Yamuna are cold and foggy. Many regular users here are older residents and visiting pilgrims. That points to gentle, seated and low-impact machines, placed where there is shade in summer and sun on winter mornings.

items.q: Can a temple trust or ashram in Mathura install an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. A courtyard corner or garden strip is often enough for three machines. Send us the size and photos, and we will suggest machines that suit older users and mark the clear space.

items.q: Which machines are safest for elderly visitors to use alone?
items.a: Seated twisters and tai chi wheels are the easiest, because the user stays seated or holds a fixed handle. They move only as fast as the person moves them.

items.q: Do you install in Vrindavan and other towns around Mathura?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from our Vasai factory by road, and our team or a north Indian dealer installs the machines at your site in Mathura district.
